# Cases whose comparison with the node oracle is not "ok" (see expect_test.go).
# id<TAB>status<TAB>reason
number-axis-format--ja-JP	differ	gap, not modelled: CJK glyphs are in neither side's fonts, so this measures a missing glyph, which is not a Vega rule: node-canvas draws Pango's hex box on Linux (pangocairo get_glyph_extents_missing, FreeType-hinted) and falls back to a system CJK font on macOS; the engine measures .notdef (see values/aggregated--beyond-ascii)
time-axis-default--zh-CN	differ	gap, not modelled: CJK glyphs are in neither side's fonts, so this measures a missing glyph, which is not a Vega rule: node-canvas draws Pango's hex box on Linux (pangocairo get_glyph_extents_missing, FreeType-hinted) and falls back to a system CJK font on macOS; the engine measures .notdef (see values/aggregated--beyond-ascii)
time-axis-default--zh-TW	differ	gap, not modelled: CJK glyphs are in neither side's fonts, so this measures a missing glyph, which is not a Vega rule: node-canvas draws Pango's hex box on Linux (pangocairo get_glyph_extents_missing, FreeType-hinted) and falls back to a system CJK font on macOS; the engine measures .notdef (see values/aggregated--beyond-ascii)
